reply.text: Shaking on a hard last set is usually just your muscles running out of fuel and fatigued fibers firing unevenly, and it tells you the set was close to your limit. It's not proof the session worked, though. What counts is whether you beat last time's reps or weight over the coming weeks. If the shaking comes with anything beyond tired muscle, like numbness, sharp pain, or it doesn't settle, that's one for a doctor or physio, not me. Which lift was it? I can check how it compares to your last few sessions.
